Asia Data Center Projects Face IPO Delays and Government Halts

Data center projects across Asia are experiencing delays in their Initial Public Offerings (IPOs) and facing government-imposed halts. Investors are reportedly wary of dedicated power projects for these data centers, contributing to the slowdown.
